summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (May 2026) with hands-on experience building multimodal ML systems and fine-tuning large language models for production. Fine-tuned DONUT — an OCR-free multimodal visual-language transformer — improving validation accuracy 55% → 93%; compressed TinyLlama 1.1B via structured pruning and 8-bit quantization with full LLM benchmark evaluation.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT — OCR-free multimodal visual-language transformer — on a custom dataset, improving validation accuracy 55% → 93% via preprocessing and model tuning.
Built end-to-end PyTorch pipelines for multimodal content understanding, standardizing training and evaluation workflows across vision-language modalities.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net with VGG-16, VGG-19, ResNet-50 backbones on BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI data; evaluated Dice Score and IoU, reporting accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: Research Intern
bullets: Architected a full visual content understanding pipeline for automated microscopic inspection using image stitching, wavelet denoising, and ZoeDepth depth estimation; achieved PSNR of 86.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced TinyLlama 1.1B memory footprint by ~25% via structured pruning and 8-bit quantization for edge LLM deployment.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; observed ~7% accuracy drop and +6.3 perplexity increase — quantified LLM efficiency-accuracy trade-offs.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR Transformer from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end multimodal ASR pipeline: 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder, 6-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention; achieved 15% WER on Hindi-English multilingual data.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with Cython-accelerated backend achieving 4–5.5× speedup over pure Python, processing 6M characters in 15 min.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms), and TensorRT-optimized YOLO (~18 FPS) into a unified multimodal inference pipeline for real-time content understanding.
Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency across vision, speech, and language modalities.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built zero-annotation data pipelines using CARLA semantic segmentation to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames — weakly-supervised content labeling at scale.
Fine-tuned YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and UFLD (ResNet-18) for video content understanding; validated zero collisions across multi-agent simulation.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
